scope.purpose: Clarify inventory reservation before implementing checkout integration
assumptions: Illustrative draft: confirm quantities, lifecycle, ownership and concurrency requirements with the domain owner before implementation
No inventory implementation or execution evidence is supplied by this example

contexts.label: Inventory
contexts.responsibility: Own available quantities and the reservation lifecycle

concepts.name: inventory.stock-item
concepts.definition: One SKU in one stock location; its available quantity excludes active reservations

concepts.name: inventory.reservation
concepts.definition: An identified claim on a positive stock quantity; active or released. Success means an active claim, not successful payment

rules.name: inventory.reservation.claim-available-quantity
rules.statement: At an atomic reservation decision, a positive requested quantity within current availability creates an active claim and reduces availability by that quantity

rules.name: inventory.reservation.keep-available-quantity-nonnegative
rules.statement: All concurrent reservation decisions preserve available quantity >= 0; a request above remaining availability is rejected for insufficient stock without creating an active claim

rules.name: inventory.reservation.release-quantity-once
rules.statement: Releasing an active reservation returns its quantity once; repeated release does not change availability

stories.name: inventory.reserve-stock-for-checkout
stories.benefit: Promise checkout stock only when an active reservation exists

stories.name: inventory.release-stock-after-cancellation
stories.benefit: Make its stock available for other checkouts

criteria.name: inventory.reservation.activate-claim-for-available-quantity
criteria.condition: At the reservation decision, the positive requested quantity is within current availability
criteria.expected: An active reservation is created for that quantity and availability decreases by the same quantity

criteria.name: inventory.reservation.prevent-overselling
criteria.condition: Concurrent requests target the same available stock
criteria.expected: Successful reservations never exceed available quantity and availability stays nonnegative; requests above remaining availability are rejected for insufficient stock without an active claim

criteria.name: inventory.reservation.make-repeated-release-idempotent
criteria.condition: The same identified reservation is released repeatedly
criteria.expected: Only its first active-to-released transition returns stock

criteria.name: inventory.reservation.restore-availability-after-release
criteria.condition: A successful reservation is later released
criteria.expected: Availability returns to its value before the reservation, absent other stock changes

cases.name: inventory.reservation.concurrent-requests-for-last-unit
cases.given: One unit available for a stock item, no active reservations; both requests are valid and there are no unrelated failures
cases.when: Two distinct requests concurrently reserve one unit each
cases.then: Exactly one succeeds with an active reservation; the other fails for insufficient stock; availability is zero

cases.name: inventory.reservation.release-same-reservation-twice
cases.given: Two units available initially; one is reserved successfully
cases.when: The same reservation is released twice
cases.then: Availability is two after each release and the reservation remains released

cases.name: inventory.reservation.reserve-and-release-without-other-changes
cases.given: Three units available initially, no other stock changes
cases.when: A request reserves two units and then releases that reservation
cases.then: Availability moves from three to one to three
